ack.limitations: Does not authenticate reviewer identity, enforce cross-process single use, persist raw transport or enforce deadlines; externally trusted review SHA is a trust input. Equivalent noncanonical JSON may parse; raw-byte digest binding remains required.

selector.historical_P2: Earlier private plan contained raw LD_LIBRARY_PATH but was insufficiently labelled; fixed by SENSITIVE_RAM_ONLY and explicit fixed-field redaction. Integration must not serialize private plans or exception debug dumps.

binder.limitations: Caller metadata/time/boot are not automatically authentic. Source pins require trusted bootstrap; mutable public candidate must be rehashed at ACK; evidence verifier, LDD verifier and release remain absent.
